circularity_prohibitions: No neighbor return, metric, score, daily-return hash, or result manifest may be an input to that neighbor's source bundle, config hash, parameter hash, trial registration, or registration SHA-256.
No neighbor result may be read before the complete ten-neighbor identity set is frozen and every neighbor is preregistered.
The post-run parameter-neighborhood evidence manifest is an organizer-derived consumer of preregistered parameter and return artifacts; it is not an executable or registration input.
A candidate cannot be declared development-qualified before the completed neighborhood evidence passes all stability thresholds.
result_read_barrier: Do not read any of the ten neighbor results until all ten registrations are first-added and their exact identities are frozen.

stages.title: center and declaration
requirements: Run the no-control center first and require every core-alpha activation threshold.
Keep the already-declared ten one-axis deltas unchanged before any neighbor result.

stages.title: non-neighborhood candidate gate
requirements: Select either the no-control center or a properly preregistered later policy only after it passes every non-neighborhood development threshold.
Freeze the selected candidate's strategy, risk, config, seed, and complete executable-source identity before materializing neighbors.

stages.title: pre-result neighbor materialization and registration
requirements: For each declared delta, create a full parameter artifact and executable strategy/config bytes whose zero-argument builder exposes exactly that neighbor.
Use the selected candidate's same risk policy and seed for every neighbor.
First-add all ten registrations serially under A7 before running or reading any neighbor result.

stages.title: serial execution behind a read barrier
requirements: Run neighbors one at a time under A7.
Stage each result without exposing it to Team09 selection until all ten runs are terminal.
Reject any result whose A5 score identity differs from its preregistration.

stages.title: post-run organizer evidence
requirements: After the barrier opens, bind each pre-existing parameter artifact and daily-return artifact into the organizer-owned neighborhood manifest.
Apply profitable-fraction >= 0.70, median Sharpe >= 0.50, and positive-PnL concentration <= 0.40.
Record failure as evidence; do not redefine or replace a failed neighbor after reading results.
